## Short answer
I could not look this up in the server you named: `io.github.acme/express-docs` was not among what the MCP registry returned, so load_plugin refused it before connecting to anything, and I did not connect to another server in its place. From memory, not checked against the docs: in Express 5 a thrown error or rejected promise in an async route handler reaches `next(err)` on its own, so `GET /orders/:id` (src/app.js:13) needs only an error-handling middleware (`app.use((err, req, res, next) => …)`) after the routes, before `app.listen` (src/app.js:18).

## Sources used
- package.json: `"express": "^5.1.0"`; src/app.js for the route.
- No documentation: the docs server you named is not in the MCP registry as a remote server.

## Left unverified
- The whole answer is from memory. Check the server's exact registry name, or tell me to use Context7 (`io.github.upstash/context7`, no key needed) and I will propose it.
- The exact Express version (only the range `^5.1.0` is known); nothing was run.
